headline: Foreign Investors Sweep NT$86.9 Billion, Fifth Largest! "These 2 Stocks" Memory Chips Surge with 70,000 Lots; Then Turn Around and Sell Off the Other - Finance
summary: The Taiex rose 892 points, or 1.9%, to close at 47,180 on the 18th, reclaiming all moving averages. Foreign investors made a net purchase of NT$86.9 billion, the fifth-largest single-day net buy on record.
why: The Taiex is Taiwan's benchmark index, heavily weighted toward semiconductor makers. Foreign flows are a key driver of its daily moves.

impacts.name: Taiex
impacts.why: The benchmark index closed up 1.9% on a rebound in US stocks and heavy foreign buying.

why_moved: US stocks rebounded strongly on Thursday after a sell-off tied to US rate-hike concerns. Foreign investors bought nearly NT$87 billion of Taiwanese shares, the fifth-largest single-day net purchase on record.
